notes.A2-0287: Main picture: a woman with rolled sleeves scrubbing a shirt on a ribbed washboard in a zinc tub of suds, a bar of soap, foam flying, a line of washing behind. The scrubbing in the suds is the subject. Insets: a washing machine with its round window; wet laundry being wrung; a line of shirts drying.
notes.A2-0288: Main picture: a boy putting books back on a shelf in a room divided by his work — the left side still strewn with toys and clothes, the right side already neat, the bed made. The act of putting things back in order is the subject. Insets: hands folding a jumper; a drawer being closed on tidy socks; the finished room.
notes.A2-0289: Main picture: a repairman in a work apron with a screwdriver inside the back of an opened radio set on a bench, valves and parts laid out, a lamp over the work, the radio's dial facing the viewer. The hands fixing the broken set are the subject. Insets: a cobbler nailing a sole; a man under a car with a spanner; a sewn patch on torn trousers.
notes.A2-0291: Main picture: a man sitting up and swinging his legs out of bed, one foot on the floor, throwing back the blanket, an alarm clock ringing on the bedside table, low morning sun through the window. The body rising from the bed is the subject. Insets: the ringing alarm clock; feet finding slippers; a stretch at the open window.
notes.A2-0292: Main picture: a woman pulling a jumper down over her head, arms up, skirt and blouse already on, an open wardrobe behind her with clothes on hangers, a mirror. The garment going on is the subject. Insets: a foot going into a shoe; hands buttoning a shirt; a coat being shrugged onto the shoulders.
notes.A2-0300: Main picture: a worker in a blue-grey jacket slumped on a bench at a factory gate at dusk, cap pushed back, eyes half closed, one hand rubbing his face, a yawn, lunch bag and tools dropped beside him. The slumped, drained figure is the subject. Insets: a woman asleep sitting upright on a bus; feet with shoes kicked off; a clock showing a late hour.
notes.A2-0309: Main picture: a man sprawled in a hammock, eyes shut, hands behind his head, while beside him a spade stands idle in an unweeded bed and a cat sleeps on the unmown grass; a neighbour over the fence works hard. The idle man is the subject. Insets: a cat sprawled asleep in the sun; a boy slumped over undone homework; a man yawning on a sofa with a broom leaning unused beside him.
notes.A2-0322: Main picture: close on a hand with the index finger pressing a large round doorbell button beside a door, the button shown pushed in, sound lines bursting from the bell above. The pressing finger on the button is the subject. Insets: a foot pressing a pedal; two hands pressing down on a suitcase lid; a finger on a lift button.
notes.A2-0323: Main picture: a woman on a pavement pushing a sealed envelope into the slot of a blue post box, the envelope half in, a wrapped parcel under her other arm, a post office door behind. The letter going into the box is the subject. Insets: a parcel on the post-office scales; a postman with a full bag; a telegram form (blank) handed through a window.
notes.A2-0325: Main picture: a hand flicking a wall switch up, the ceiling lamp above bursting into light with bold rays, the room bright. The switch going up and the lamp lighting are the subject. Insets: a plug pushed into a socket; a radio dial lighting as a knob turns; a television screen coming on.
notes.A2-0326: Main picture: a hand flicking a wall switch down, the ceiling lamp above dark and the room dim, a small arrow at the switch pointing down. The switch going down and the lamp going dark are the subject. Insets: a plug pulled from a socket; a radio knob turned with the dial dark; a dark television screen.
notes.A2-0327: Main picture: a storm over a village street — trees bent double, rain driving sideways, a fork of lightning, a roof tile flying, a man clutching his hat and coat, a bus shelter with people sheltering. The wind and rain tearing at everything are the subject. Insets: waves breaking over a pier; an umbrella blown inside out; a dark cloud mass with lightning.
notes.A2-0328: Main picture: thick fog on a river — trees and a bridge fading into pale grey, a figure with a lantern half dissolved in it, a rowing boat near the bank, everything soft-edged. The grey veil hiding the view is the subject. Insets: car headlights in fog; a church tower with only its top showing above fog; a road vanishing into white.
notes.A2-0329: Main picture: an autumn dawn — white rime on grass, fence and roof, a puddle with a skin of ice, a woman covering tomato plants with cloth, breath visible. The white frost coating is the subject. Insets: a frosted leaf close; a frosted window pane; a thermometer just below zero.
notes.A2-0333: Main picture: a lone tree in bright sun casting a sharp dark shadow across the grass, the black arrow on the shadow itself, a man resting in the shade. The shadow is the subject. Insets: a figure's long shadow on a pavement; a sundial; a hand making a shadow on a wall.
notes.A2-0403: Main picture: a man stepping over the threshold into a house, one foot inside, the door held open, the street behind him, a bold black arrow beside him pointing inward. The crossing of the threshold inward is the subject. Insets: a crowd entering a theatre door; a dog going into a kennel; the door from inside with the man coming through.
notes.A2-0404: Main picture: a man stepping out of a house onto the street, one foot on the step, pulling the door shut behind him, a bold arrow beside him pointing outward and away. The crossing of the threshold outward is the subject. Insets: a crowd leaving a cinema; a cat leaving through a flap; the empty doorway with the man already down the path.
notes.A2-0405: Main picture: a man with a suitcase and coat walking up the garden path to his lit house at dusk, his wife and child in the open door, a bold arrow curving round from the road back to the house. The homecoming is the subject. Insets: a boomerang-like curved arrow over a road; a bus pulling in at the home stop; a key turning in the own front door.
notes.A2-0407: Main picture: a man climbing a wooden ladder leaning against an apple tree, halfway up, both hands gripping rungs and one foot raised to the next, a basket hanging from the ladder. The body going up the rungs is the subject. Insets: a child climbing stairs; a man climbing a rock face; a cat up a tree trunk.
notes.A2-0412: Main picture: a woman in a coat half-running along a pavement, handbag flying out behind, one hand holding her hat, looking at her wristwatch, a bus at the stop ahead with its doors open. The headlong hurry is the subject. Insets: a man gulping coffee standing; a clock with the hands near the hour; feet in long stride.
notes.A2-0413: Main picture: a man standing alone at a bus stop, looking down the long empty road, wristwatch raised, a suitcase at his feet, the stop sign post beside him. The waiting figure looking down the road is the subject. Insets: a woman on a bench with a bunch of flowers, looking at the clock; a dog sitting at a shop door; a queue at a closed window.
notes.A2-0414: Main picture: two friends meeting on a street, arms thrown wide as they recognise each other, one has dropped his bag, faces lit up, a step apart. The moment of meeting is the subject. Insets: a handshake; a couple meeting under the station clock; two cars stopped nose to nose on a lane with drivers waving.
notes.A2-0417: Main picture: a waiter carrying a tray with two cups and a plate of cake toward a seated couple, arriving at their table, a bold arrow from the kitchen door to the table. The carrying toward the people is the subject. Insets: a dog bringing a stick to its owner; a child bringing flowers to its mother; a postman handing over a parcel at a door.
notes.A2-0419: Main picture: a woman placing a loaf onto a table, her hand still on it, the loaf just touching the surface, a basket of groceries waiting beside. The act of setting the thing down is the subject. Insets: a hand putting a book on a shelf; coins put into a purse; a hat put on a hook.
notes.A2-0424: Main picture: a woman stepping up into a bus, one foot on the high step and a hand on the rail, the driver waiting, a bold arrow up into the door. The getting into the vehicle is the subject. Insets: a man climbing into a train carriage; a child lifted into a cart; a cyclist mounting.
notes.A2-0425: Main picture: a man stepping down from a bus door onto the pavement, bag in hand, a bold arrow out and down from the door. The getting off the vehicle is the subject. Insets: a passenger stepping down from a train; a woman climbing out of a car; a boy jumping off a cart.
notes.A2-0426: Main picture: a man in a jacket speaking to three listeners in a yard, mouth open mid-word, one hand raised in a gesture, a speech bubble above him containing only a wavy line. The speaking mouth and gesture are the subject. Insets: two women talking over a fence with bubbles; a man speaking into a telephone receiver; a face in profile with the mouth open and sound lines.
notes.A2-0434: Main picture: a woman at her open front door beckoning with her whole arm to a neighbour on the path, a smile, a set table with cake visible in the room behind. The beckoning gesture at the open door is the subject. Insets: a hand holding out an invitation card (blank with a drawn cake); a man waving two friends over to his table; a wedding couple handing cards.
notes.A2-0442: Main picture: a man on a river bank shouting across the water, hands cupped around his open mouth, bold sound lines fanning out, a figure on the far bank turning. The shout itself is the subject. Insets: a child calling for a dog with sound lines; a market woman calling her wares; a referee with a whistle.
notes.A2-0445: Main picture: close on hands — one pressing a telephone receiver to the shoulder, the other writing with a pencil in a small notebook, the lines appearing as wavy strokes. The pencil putting words down is the subject. Insets: a shopping list being written at a kitchen table; a waiter writing an order; a hand noting a number on a palm.
notes.A2-0454: Main picture: a boy backing against a fence, eyes wide, mouth open, hands raised in front of him, knees bent, a large dog barking at him with bared teeth. The fear in the body is the subject. Insets: a woman on a chair with a mouse below; a hand over a face peeking through fingers; a child hiding behind a mother's skirt.
notes.A2-0466: Main picture: a demolition — a wrecking ball on a crane smashing through a brick wall, bricks flying, dust, a bulldozer pushing rubble, workers in helmets. The wall coming down is the subject. Insets: a man with a sledgehammer at a wall; a sandcastle kicked over; a house of cards collapsing.
notes.A2-0472: Main picture: a man filling a bucket at a yard tap, water pouring in and brimming over the rim, a second full bucket beside. The vessel being filled to the brim is the subject. Insets: a glass filled from a jug; a petrol tank filled; a sack filled with grain.
notes.A2-0473: Main picture: a woman upending a bucket, water pouring out onto the yard, the bucket now empty, an arrow from the bucket to the ground. The emptying out is the subject. Insets: a bin emptied into a lorry; pockets turned out; a glass drunk to the bottom.
notes.A2-0477: Main picture: close on a hand turning a key in the lock of a closed front door, the key half turned, the bolt shown engaged, a small arrow turning. The key locking the door is the subject. Insets: a padlock snapped shut on a shed; a car door key turned; a bicycle chained to a rail.
notes.A2-0478: Main picture: close on a hand turning a key in a front-door lock, the door already open a hand's width with light from inside, a small arrow turning the other way. The key opening the door is the subject. Insets: an open padlock hanging from its hasp; a key withdrawn from a lock; a shed door swinging open.
notes.A2-0479: Main picture: close on two hands tying a knot in a rope around a bundle of firewood, the loop half pulled tight. The knot being made is the subject. Insets: a boot lace being tied; a boat tied to a post; a scarf knotted at the neck.
notes.A2-0483: Main picture: a pot on a gas ring boiling hard, bubbles breaking the surface, steam rising thick, potatoes visible, a woman lifting the lid with a cloth. The boiling water is the subject. Insets: a kettle boiling with its whistle; eggs in a saucepan of bubbling water; a thermometer at the boiling mark.
notes.A2-0484: Main picture: a woman in an apron sliding a tray of buns into an open oven whose interior glows, heat lines, a frying pan sizzling with an egg on the ring above. The food going into the heat is the subject. Insets: a pan with frying eggs; a loaf coming out brown; a cutlet turning in a pan.
notes.A2-0486: Main picture: close on a hand tilting a jug, a thick stream of milk arcing into a glass on a table, the glass half full. The pouring stream is the subject. Insets: tea poured from a pot into a cup; water from a bucket into a trough; petrol from a can into a car.
notes.A2-0487: Main picture: a market woman weighing apples on a two-pan balance, adding one apple to the pan, the needle swinging, a buyer watching with a string bag. The scales in use are the subject. Insets: a man on a bathroom scale; a baby on a clinic scale; a weight alone.
notes.A2-0494: Main picture: a young man taking a heavy shopping bag from an old woman and steadying her by the arm on a stairway, her other hand on the rail, both looking at the steps. The supporting hands are the subject. Insets: a man pushing a stalled car with its driver; a girl holding a ladder for her father; a hand pulling a fallen skater up.
notes.A2-0501: Main picture: a family of six around a table laden with dishes, all raising glasses in a toast, a cake with candles in the centre, paper garlands and balloons overhead, an accordion player at the end. The toast over the festive table is the subject. Insets: the cake with lit candles; a wrapped gift; two glasses clinking.
notes.A2-0504: Main picture: a maternity ward — a midwife in a white coat placing a newborn wrapped in a blanket into the arms of its mother sitting up in bed, a cradle beside the bed, a window with morning light. The newborn placed in the mother's arms is the subject. Insets: a cradle alone; a father with flowers at the ward door; a calf being born in a barn with the cow standing over it.
notes.A2-0533: Main picture: a shop front with its door shut, the blind drawn down inside the glass and a padlock on the hasp, the black arrow on this door; the neighbouring shop door stands open with a customer going in. The shut door is the subject. Insets: a closed book; a closed window with the curtain drawn; a closed box lid.
notes.A2-0534: Main picture: two glasses side by side on a table, the left filled to the brim with water, the black arrow on it, the right empty. The brimming glass is the subject. Insets: a full bus with faces at every window; a full basket of apples; a full moon.
notes.A2-0535: Main picture: two glasses side by side, the right one empty and dry, the black arrow on it, the left full. The empty glass is the subject. Insets: an empty bus with empty seats; an empty basket; an empty room with bare walls.
notes.A2-0540: Main picture: a chalkboard with two short sums in digits only — one with a wrong total, a bold red cross beside it and the black arrow on it; the other correct with a green tick. The crossed, wrong sum is the subject. Insets: a man walking the wrong way past a one-way arrow; a sock on the wrong foot; a key beside the wrong lock.
notes.A2-0559: Main picture: a man sunk into a deep soft armchair, feet on a footstool, hands folded, eyes closed in contentment, the black arrow on the chair; beside it, a hard wooden stool on which a second man sits stiffly. The comfortable chair is the subject. Insets: soft slippers; a wide bed with pillows; a wide bus seat.
notes.A2-0564: Main picture: a man at a table with a spoon of soup at his lips, eyes closed, face blissful, thumb raised, steam from the bowl, the cook watching pleased. The delighted taster is the subject. Insets: a child licking a plate; a cake with a slice gone; lips smacking.
notes.A2-0566: Main picture: a baker's counter — a loaf just drawn from the oven, steam rising, the black arrow on it, beside it a crisp green lettuce with water drops and a fish on ice with a bright eye. The just-made, just-picked food is the subject. Insets: a newly laid egg in a nest; a cut flower with dew; a fish on ice.
notes.A2-0568: Main picture: a spoon of honey dripping into a bowl, sugar cubes and a slice of cake beside, a child licking a finger with a happy face, the black arrow on the honey. The honey is the subject. Insets: a bee on a flower; a jar of jam; a chocolate bar.
notes.A2-0569: Main picture: a man biting into a lemon slice with his face screwed up and one eye shut, the black arrow on the lemon, a jar of gherkins and a bowl of sauerkraut beside. The puckering at the sour fruit is the subject. Insets: a lemon cut open; a glass of kefir; a cranberry.
notes.A2-0570: Main picture: a salt cellar pouring a stream of salt onto a herring on a plate, the black arrow on the salt, a man at the table grimacing and reaching for a glass of water. The salt on the food is the subject. Insets: a sea wave; salted fish hanging; a pile of salt crystals.
notes.A2-0571: Main picture: a man pulling a face at a cup of very black coffee, the black arrow on the cup, a sprig of wormwood and a slab of very dark chocolate beside. The bitter taste is the subject. Insets: a mouth turned down after a sip; a bottle of medicine with a spoon; a dandelion leaf bitten.
notes.A2-0572: Main picture: a red chilli pepper and a pepper grinder beside a plate of stew, the black arrow on the chilli, a man with his mouth open fanning it with his hand, eyes watering. The hot pepper is the subject. Insets: a garlic bulb; a mustard pot; flames drawn above a tongue.
notes.A2-0578: Main picture: a lanky teenage boy of about fifteen, jeans and a sports jacket, a cassette player on his belt, satchel over one shoulder, standing between a small child and a grown man so his in-between height shows, the black arrow on him. The adolescent is the subject. Insets: a teenage girl with a school bag; a group of teenagers on a bench; the boy's face with first down on the lip.
notes.A2-0589: Main picture: a man in his Sunday best arriving at a flat door with a bunch of flowers and a cake box, the hostess taking his coat, the host shaking his hand, a set table behind. The arriving visitor with his gifts is the subject. Insets: slippers offered to the guest; the guest at the table being served; the doorbell being rung.
notes.A2-0595: Main picture: a man and a woman walking arm in arm along a park path, heads inclined toward each other, matching step, a bench and trees behind. The two together as a pair are the subject. Insets: two wedding rings; the pair dancing; two cups on one tray.
notes.A2-0600: Main picture: a patient seated in profile with the mouth wide open, a doctor in a white coat pressing the tongue down with a spatula and looking in, the black arrow on the front of the neck at the throat. The throat is the subject. Insets: a cross-section of the throat behind the tongue; a hand on a sore neck with a scarf; a man swallowing with the throat marked.
notes.A2-0601: Main picture: a man stripped to the waist, seen from the front, the black arrow on the broad of his chest, a doctor pressing a stethoscope there. The chest is the subject. Insets: a woman with a hand pressed to her chest; a chest expanding with a deep breath; a medal pinned on a chest.
notes.A2-0602: Main picture: a stout man seen from the side, shirt stretched over a round belly, both hands holding it, the black arrow on the belly. The belly is the subject. Insets: a child with a sore stomach bending over; a pregnant woman's profile; a full plate pushed away.
notes.A2-0613: Main picture: a flight of concrete stairs in a panel-block stairwell seen from below, a woman with a shopping bag climbing them, a handrail, a landing window. The steps themselves are the subject. Insets: a child's feet on steps; a wooden farmhouse stair; a spiral stair in a tower.
notes.A2-0615: Main picture: the façade of a five-storey panel block with one balcony large in the centre — a railing, a man leaning on it with a cup looking out, washing on a line, a pot of geraniums. The balcony jutting from the wall is the subject. Insets: the balcony seen from inside through the door; a row of balconies down the block; a cat on a balcony rail.
notes.A2-0618: Main picture: a brick garage with its up-and-over door raised, a Zhiguli inside, shelves of tins and tools on the wall, a man in overalls wiping his hands with a rag. The car housed in its garage is the subject. Insets: a row of garage doors; the garage padlocked; an inspection pit with a man in it.
notes.A2-0623: Main picture: a single wooden shelf on brackets fixed to a wall, books, a clock and a jar standing on it, the black arrow on the shelf board itself. The shelf is the subject. Insets: a shop shelf of tins; a bookcase of many shelves; a hand placing a cup on a shelf.
notes.A2-0626: Main picture: a framed wall mirror seen head-on, a woman seen from behind combing her hair, her face reflected in the glass. The reflecting glass is the subject. Insets: a hand mirror; a man shaving at a small mirror; a lake reflecting trees.
notes.A2-0644: Main picture: a village seen from a low rise — a dozen wooden farmhouses with carved gables along a dirt road, well sweeps, picket fences, a small wooden chapel, cows in a meadow, fields and forest beyond. The cluster of farmsteads is the subject. Insets: a single farmhouse with its well; a woman carrying buckets on a yoke; a horse cart on the road.
notes.A2-0645: Main picture: a town square from eye level — a wide open paved space, the town hall with a tower on the far side, a fountain, benches, people crossing diagonally, a trolleybus along one edge. The open paved space ringed by buildings is the subject. Insets: a market set up on the square; the fountain; pigeons on the paving.
notes.A2-0649: Main picture: a post office hall — a row of counters with clerks behind glass, a woman weighing a parcel on a letter scale, a man licking a stamp, sacks of mail, a blue post box by the door. The counters with letters and parcels are the subject. Insets: the post box outside; a postman's bicycle with bags; a bundle of letters tied with string.
notes.A2-0650: Main picture: a small police station — a brick building with a lamp over the door and barred lower windows, a policeman in uniform at the entrance desk inside with a telephone and ledger, a tricolour by the door, a Zhiguli with a roof light outside. The station with its policeman at the desk is the subject. Insets: a policeman's cap and whistle; a cell door with a small window; the patrol car.
notes.A2-0651: Main picture: a fire station — two red ZIL fire engines with ladders in the open bays, firemen in helmets and canvas coats rolling a hose, the hose-drying tower behind. The engines in their bays are the subject. Insets: a fireman sliding down a pole; a brass helmet; a hose nozzle spraying.
notes.A2-0652: Main picture: a museum gallery — glass display cases with ancient pots, amber and a sword, paintings on the walls, visitors leaning to look, an elderly attendant on a chair in the corner. The exhibits in their cases are the subject. Insets: a museum façade with columns; a mammoth skeleton in a hall; a child pressing a nose to a case.
notes.A2-0653: Main picture: a cinema hall from the back — rows of heads in seats, the big bright screen showing a scene of a galloping horse, the projector beam cutting the dark. The screen and the watching rows are the subject. Insets: the cinema façade with a poster frame (blank); a ticket torn in half; a projector with its reels.
notes.A2-0654: Main picture: a stadium seen from high in the stands — the oval of packed terraces, the green pitch with a match in play, floodlight pylons. The bowl of stands around the pitch is the subject. Insets: a running track lane; a scoreboard with only two digits; a crowd with flags.
notes.A2-0658: Main picture: a cemetery under old trees — rows of graves with wooden and stone crosses, candle lanterns, a woman kneeling to plant flowers on one, a small chapel. The graves with their crosses are the subject. Insets: a single cross with a lit candle; a wreath; a funeral procession at the gate.
notes.A2-0659: Main picture: a bus stop — a concrete shelter with a bench, the stop sign on its post (a blank disc), six people waiting, a bus just pulling in with its doors opening. The shelter and sign with the arriving bus are the subject. Insets: the stop sign alone; a timetable board with only a grid; feet stepping onto the bus step.
notes.A2-0660: Main picture: a zebra crossing seen at an angle — bold white stripes across the asphalt, a mother and child and a man crossing on them, a Zhiguli stopped at the line, a crossing sign post. The striped crossing with people on it is the subject. Insets: the pedestrian signal light; a hand on a child's hand at the kerb; the stripes from above.
notes.A2-0661: Main picture: a pavement along a town street — paving slabs, the kerb with a drain, pedestrians walking, a pram, the roadway with a Zhiguli beside it, the black arrow on the pavement. The walkway beside the road is the subject. Insets: the kerb edge close; a yard-keeper sweeping the pavement; a bench on the pavement.
notes.A2-0662: Main picture: a three-lamp traffic light on a post at a crossroads, the red lamp lit, cars stopped at the line, pedestrians waiting at the kerb. The lit signal is the subject. Insets: the three lamps red, amber, green; a pedestrian light with a standing man; a policeman directing with a baton where the lights are dark.
notes.A2-0664: Main picture: a petrol station — a pump with its hose in the filler of a Zhiguli, an attendant in overalls holding the nozzle, the canopy, a small kiosk, a lorry waiting. The pump filling the car is the subject. Insets: the pump nozzle; a petrol can; the price board with digits only.
notes.A2-0665: Main picture: a car park — rows of Zhigulis and Moskviches parked in painted bays, a striped barrier at the entrance, a man locking his car, a block of flats behind. The parked rows are the subject. Insets: a parking sign with the letter P (allowed glyph) or a blank disc; a car reversing into a bay; the barrier lifting.
notes.A2-0666: Main picture: a grand plastered town house behind railings, two flags over the entrance — a plain blue flag of a foreign state and the Lithuanian tricolour — a brass plate left blank, a doorman, a queue of people with papers at a side door. The flagged official residence is the subject. Insets: a passport being stamped with a visa; the two flags; a black car with a small flag.
notes.A2-0717: Main picture: close on a jacket front with its zip — the slider halfway up, a hand pulling it, the interlocking teeth above and the open halves below. The zip with its slider is the subject. Insets: a zip on a bag; a zip on a boot; the slider alone.
notes.A2-0722: Main picture: a tram in profile on rails set in a cobbled street, its pole on the overhead wire, doors open, passengers boarding, the rails curving away. The rail car in the street is the subject. Insets: the rails in the cobbles close; the tram interior; the pole and wire.
notes.A2-0723: Main picture: a Škoda trolleybus in profile at a stop, its two poles up on the overhead wires, doors open, passengers boarding, a town street behind. The trolleybus with its poles on the wires is the subject. Insets: the poles and wires close; the interior with hanging straps; the driver's cab.
notes.A2-0724: Main picture: a Volga taxi at a kerb, a lit roof box and a chequered band along the side, a passenger with a case getting into the back, the driver turned to him. The marked car taking a fare is the subject. Insets: the roof sign; the meter on the dashboard with blank digits; a taxi rank with three cars.
notes.A2-0727: Main picture: a car wheel — black tyre on a steel rim with a hubcap — standing upright beside a jacked-up Zhiguli with a bare hub, a man with a wheel wrench. The wheel is the subject. Insets: a bicycle wheel with spokes; a cart wheel; a hand turning a steering wheel.
notes.A2-0729: Main picture: a bus driver in a uniform cap at the big wheel, seen from the aisle, his hands on the wheel, the road through the windscreen, passengers behind him. The person at the wheel is the subject. Insets: a lorry driver leaning from his cab window; a woman at a Zhiguli wheel; a hand on a gear lever.
notes.A2-0730: Main picture: a passenger seated by a bus window, bag on knees, ticket in hand, looking out at the passing street, the driver small at the front. The person riding is the subject. Insets: passengers standing holding straps; a passenger boarding a train with a case; a child at a train window.
notes.A2-0732: Main picture: two Zhigulis crashed head-on at a crossroads, bonnets crumpled, glass on the road, a wheel off, the two drivers arguing, a policeman with a notebook, onlookers. The wreckage of the collision is the subject. Insets: an ambulance arriving; a bicycle under a lorry wheel; a shattered headlamp.
notes.A2-0737: Main picture: a wide flat field of young green corn stretching to a distant line of trees, a tractor small at the far edge, a skylark above, a path along the margin. The open cultivated ground is the subject. Insets: a field of stubble with sheaves; a ploughed field in furrows; a potato field being dug.
notes.A2-0742: Main picture: the sea coast seen along its length — waves breaking on a wide sandy shore, low dunes with marram grass and pines behind, a lighthouse far along, gulls. The meeting line of land and sea is the subject. Insets: a fishing boat drawn up on the sand; a pier; shells and amber at the water's edge.
notes.A2-0743: Main picture: a river bank — a grassy slope with willows coming down to the water, a man sitting on it fishing, a rowing boat tied to a post, the far bank visible across the river. The edge of land along the water is the subject. Insets: feet dangling over the bank; a lake shore with reeds; a cow drinking at the bank.
notes.A2-0745: Main picture: a narrow footpath of trodden earth winding between trees and grass, a woman with a basket walking along it, the path curving out of sight. The narrow track is the subject. Insets: a path through a meadow; a path of flagstones in a garden; footprints in snow along a track.
notes.A2-0746: Main picture: an apple tree with one large branch in the foreground, the black arrow on the branch itself, leaves and apples on it, a boy sitting astride a higher branch. The branch is the subject. Insets: a bare winter branch; a broken branch on the ground; a bird on a twig.
notes.A2-0757: Main picture: a brown hen in side profile pecking at grain in a farmyard, comb and wattles, chicks around her feet, a cockerel on a fence behind. The live hen is the subject. Insets: the hen on a nest box with eggs; the hen's head close; a woman scattering grain.
notes.A2-0782: Main picture: an engineer at a drawing board with a large technical drawing of a bridge (lines only), a slide rule and compasses in hand, a hard hat on the desk, a model girder beside him. The man at the technical drawing is the subject. Insets: the engineer in a hard hat at a building site pointing; the slide rule and compasses; a turbine on a drawing.
notes.A2-0784: Main picture: a male nurse in a white coat and cap taking the pulse of a patient in bed, watch in his other hand, a trolley of bottles and a thermometer beside, a ward behind. The nurse at the bedside is the subject. Insets: a syringe being filled; a bandage being wound on an arm; the nurse pushing a wheelchair.
notes.A2-0788: Main picture: a farmer in a flat cap, jacket and rubber boots leaning on a pitchfork beside a loaded hay cart, a horse in harness, a barn and three cows behind. The man of the farm with his tools and animals is the subject. Insets: hands milking a cow; a sack of grain on a shoulder; a tractor.
notes.A2-0789: Main picture: a builder in a helmet and overalls laying a brick onto a half-built wall with a trowel of mortar, a line stretched along the course, scaffolding behind. The man laying the wall is the subject. Insets: a wheelbarrow of mortar; a plumb line; a crane lifting a panel.
notes.A2-0791: Main picture: a musician playing an accordion on a small village stage, eyes closed, fingers on the keys, a violinist and a drummer beside him, notes drawn in the air. The player with his instrument is the subject. Insets: hands on a violin; a trumpet player; an instrument case open with coins.
notes.A2-0792: Main picture: a writer at a desk hammering a typewriter, a stack of typed pages, a pen and an inkwell, shelves of books behind, a cat on the sill. The person producing pages is the subject. Insets: a bound book with the writer's portrait inside the cover; a hand with a pen over a page of wavy lines; a reading at a lectern.
notes.A2-0794: Main picture: a scientist in a white coat at a laboratory bench looking into a microscope, flasks and test tubes in racks, a notebook with wavy lines, a periodic-table-like blank wall chart. The researcher at the bench is the subject. Insets: a flask bubbling over a burner; a telescope at an observatory; a hand pipetting.
notes.A2-0795: Main picture: a classroom — four rows of wooden double desks with pupils in white collars, the teacher at a chalkboard with a simple diagram, a map and a potted plant, big windows. The room of desks and board is the subject. Insets: a desk with an open book and inkwell; the chalkboard and duster; the corridor door with a number disc blank.
notes.A2-0796: Main picture: a dark green chalkboard filling a classroom wall, a simple chalk diagram of a circle and triangle, a teacher pointing with a stick, a duster and chalk on the ledge. The board is the subject. Insets: a hand writing a wavy line in chalk; a wooden plank (the other meaning) on a sawbench; a noticeboard with blank papers.
notes.A2-0803: Main picture: a pupil at a desk with a hand raised high, a speech bubble over her containing one bold question mark and nothing else, the teacher turning. The question-mark bubble over the raised hand is the subject. Insets: a man asking directions with a question-mark bubble; a hand knocking at an information window; the question mark alone.
notes.A2-0812: Main picture: a concert hall — an orchestra and choir on the stage, the conductor with his baton raised, the audience filling the rows below, music stands, chandeliers. The performers before the audience are the subject. Insets: a violinist bowing; a programme leaflet with a drawn lyre; applauding hands.
notes.A2-0813: Main picture: a gallery exhibition — paintings hung in a row on white walls, visitors strolling and pausing before them, a sculpture on a plinth, a woman cutting a ribbon at the entrance. The displayed works with their viewers are the subject. Insets: an agricultural show with a prize cow and rosette; a glass case of amber; a poster frame left blank.
notes.A2-0821: Main picture: a village celebration — a long table under lindens with food and drink, paper garlands between the trees, an accordion player, couples dancing, a bonfire, everyone in Sunday best. The festivity itself is the subject. Insets: a cake with candles; a decorated fir with gifts; a wreath of oak leaves.
notes.A2-0823: Main picture: a party in a small flat — six young friends dancing to a record player, glasses and plates of snacks on a table, a girl laughing, lamps low, coats piled on a chair. The dancing group in the flat is the subject. Insets: the record spinning; two glasses clinking; a cake being cut.
notes.A2-0831: Main picture: a child leaning to blow out the candles on a cake, cheeks puffed, friends around the table in paper hats clapping, wrapped gifts, a garland. The cake with its candles and the celebrating child are the subject. Insets: a gift being unwrapped; a calendar page with one day circled; a grandmother with a cake and many candles.
notes.A2-0865: Main picture: a small copper coin very large with the numeral 1, a scattering of small copper coins and one euro coin for scale beside it. The small coin is the subject. Insets: coins in a palm; a jar of coins; a vending slot.
notes.A2-1198: Main picture: a thin man at a table staring at his empty plate, hand pressed to his stomach, wavy rumble lines from the belly, a drop at the mouth, the black arrow on him; at the next seat a stout man eats from a full plate. The hungry man is the subject. Insets: a dog looking up at a sausage; an empty bowl licked clean; a clock near the dinner hour.
notes.A2-1199: Main picture: a round wooden table with a round plate on it, the black arrow on the table top, and beside it a square table with a square tray. The round shape is the subject. Insets: a ball; a full moon; a coin.
notes.A2-1200: Main picture: two identical table lamps side by side, the right dark with its switch down, the black arrow on it; the left lit. The dark, off lamp is the subject. Insets: a radio with a dark dial; a blank television screen; a gas ring with no flame and the knob turned to the stop.
notes.A2-1201: Main picture: a frying pan with a fried egg, crisp edges, the black arrow on it; beside the pan an egg cup with a boiled egg for contrast. The fried food is the subject. Insets: fried potatoes in a pan; a roast chicken brown from the oven; a cutlet frying.
notes.A2-1202: Main picture: a laughing boy swinging high, arms thrown up, mouth open in a laugh, the black arrow on him; on the next swing a boy sits still with a downturned mouth. The cheerful child is the subject. Insets: a laughing face close; a dancing couple; a dog wagging its tail.
notes.A2-1203: Main picture: two planks on a bench, the near one perfectly flat and level with a hand running along it, the black arrow on it; the far one warped and bumpy. The even surface is the subject. Insets: a calm lake surface; a smooth road; a spirit level on a shelf.
notes.A2-1204: Main picture: a woman in a loose dress standing in profile, visibly pregnant, one hand resting on the high curve of her belly, the other on her back, her husband sanding a cradle behind. The expectant woman is the subject. Insets: baby clothes on a line; the cradle; the woman at a clinic with a nurse measuring the belly.
notes.A2-1205: Main picture: a smokehouse interior — sausages and a ham hanging on hooks in curling smoke from a smouldering alder fire below, the meat dark brown, the black arrow on it. The smoke-cured meat is the subject. Insets: a smoked fish on a plate; a slice of smoked ham; the smokehouse hut outside with smoke from its roof.
notes.A2-1206: Main picture: a wooden chair lying on its side with one leg snapped off, splinters, the black arrow on the break; a whole chair stands beside it. The broken object is the subject. Insets: a cracked cup; a bicycle with a bent wheel; a snapped pencil.
notes.A2-1207: Main picture: a room split in two — the left half tidy, bed made, books squared on the shelf, shoes in a row, the black arrow on it; the right half strewn with clothes and papers. The orderly half is the subject. Insets: a neatly set table; a man with a straight tie and combed hair; a tidy desk.
notes.A2-1209: Main picture: a pot of boiled potatoes just drained, steam rising, the black arrow on them; beside it a pan of fried potatoes for contrast. The boiled food is the subject. Insets: a boiled egg cut open; boiled dumplings in a bowl; a steaming pot on a ring.
notes.A2-1210: Main picture: two identical table lamps side by side, the left lit with bold rays, its switch up, the black arrow on it; the right dark. The lit, on lamp is the subject. Insets: a radio with a glowing dial; a television showing a picture; a gas ring burning.
notes.A2-1211: Main picture: a hand pressed against rough, deeply ridged pine bark, the black arrow on the bark, and beside it a smooth polished stone held in the other hand for contrast. The rough surface is the subject. Insets: sandpaper; a rough woollen cloth; a man's unshaven cheek.
notes.A2-1212: Main picture: a hand gently stroking a kitten curled in a lap, the black arrow on the kitten's fur, a down pillow and a feather beside. The softness under the hand is the subject. Insets: a mother's hand on a baby's cheek; a wool blanket; a soft summer breeze bending grass.
notes.A2-1213: Main picture: a hotel reception desk — a woman in a neat jacket handing a key with a tag to a guest with a suitcase, a board of keys on hooks behind her, a ledger and a bell on the desk. The person behind the desk handing over the key is the subject. Insets: the board of keys; the ledger and pen; the guest signing (wavy line).
notes.A2-1215: Main picture: a long straight walk between two rows of lindens, gravel underfoot, benches, strollers and a pram, buildings behind the trees — Kaunas Laisvės alėja. The tree-lined walk is the subject. Insets: a bench under a linden; the double row of trunks receding; a cyclist.
notes.A2-1219: Main picture: a café table just vacated — a saucer with the paid bill slip and three coins left on top of it, the waiter's hand reaching to take them, the diner putting on his coat in the background. The coins left for the waiter are the subject. Insets: a coin pressed into a porter's hand; a hairdresser's tip jar with coins; a taxi passenger waving away the change.
notes.A2-1221: Main picture: a steeply tiered lecture hall, students on the benches writing, a lecturer at a lectern below a wide chalkboard with a diagram, tall windows. The tiered hall is the subject. Insets: a student taking notes; the lectern; the hall doors with a disc blank.
notes.A2-1222: Main picture: a young woman in a plain dress pushing a pram with one hand and leading a toddler by the hand with the other along a park path, the parents nowhere in view. The hired carer with the two children is the subject. Insets: the nanny spoon-feeding the baby; reading a picture book to the toddler; a pram alone.
notes.A2-1224: Main picture: a bus station — a row of bays with Ikarus and LAZ coaches nose-in, a glass waiting hall with benches, travellers with bags and children. The coaches at their bays are the subject. Insets: the ticket window; a bay post with a blank disc; a coach pulling out.
notes.A2-1225: Main picture: a street vending machine for soda water — a grey metal box with a glass standing in a lit niche, a coin slot and a button, a boy rinsing the glass and drinking. The machine giving out a drink for a coin is the subject. Insets: the coin going into the slot; the glass filling; a cigarette machine.
notes.A2-1226: Main picture: a workshop — a Zhiguli raised on a lift, a mechanic beneath it with a lamp and spanner, tyres stacked, a bench of tools, a second car with its bonnet up. The car on the lift with its mechanic is the subject. Insets: a wheel being changed; an oil can; the open bonnet.
notes.A2-1228: Main picture: a corridor ending in a steel door with a push bar, a lit green sign above it carrying only the running-man pictogram and an arrow, a man hurrying toward it. The marked emergency door is the subject. Insets: the pictogram alone; a fire-escape stair outside; a break-glass box.
notes.A2-1231: Main picture: a small room with two narrow beds, two desks heaped with books, a kettle on a stool, two students — one studying, one making tea — suitcases under the beds, a long corridor through the open door. The shared student room is the subject. Insets: the corridor with many doors; a shared kitchen; a noticeboard with blank papers.
notes.A2-1232: Main picture: a school laboratory bench with a microscope, a potted plant with roots exposed in a jar, a frog in a jar, a small skeleton model and a wall chart of a leaf cross-section, a pupil looking into the microscope. The living things under study are the subject. Insets: a cell drawn large; a butterfly pinned in a case; a heart diagram.
notes.A2-1235: Main picture: a laboratory bench with flasks and test tubes of coloured liquids, one bubbling over a burner with vapour, a student in a white coat and goggles pouring from one into another, a rack of tubes. The reacting liquids in glass are the subject. Insets: a single test tube close; a periodic-table wall chart as a grid of plain squares; a crystal in a dish.
notes.A2-1236: Main picture: a man in a suit singing at a stand microphone on a stage, mouth wide, one hand raised, musical notes drawn in the air, a small band behind. The singing mouth at the microphone is the subject. Insets: a woman singer with a songbook; a record sleeve with a portrait; notes alone.
notes.A2-1237: Main picture: a worker in a blue-grey jacket, flat cap and kirza boots standing with a wrench at a lathe, a factory hall with machines behind him. The man in work dress at his machine is the subject. Insets: hands with a wrench on a bolt; a lunch pail; the factory gate at shift change.
notes.A2-1240: Main picture: a five-storey prefabricated panel block, rows of identical windows and balconies with washing, three entrances, a yard with a bench, a sandpit and a beaten-rug frame. The block of flats is the subject. Insets: a stairwell door; a balcony close; the block at night with lit windows.
notes.A2-1245: Main picture: a workshop — a heavy bench with a vice, tools hung on the wall, sawdust on the floor, a man planing a board, shavings curling. The workbench with its tools is the subject. Insets: a vice gripping a pipe; a wall of hanging tools; a pot-bellied stove in the corner.
notes.A2-1246: Main picture: a cloakroom counter — rows of coats on hooks behind it, an attendant handing a numbered tag (blank disc) to a woman giving up her coat, a queue in evening dress. The coats behind the counter are the subject. Insets: the tag; a hat on a shelf; the counter from behind.
notes.A2-1250: Main picture: a cooker ring burning with a blue flame under a kettle, a red gas cylinder with its hose beside the cooker, a hand turning the knob. The blue flame from the cylinder is the subject. Insets: the cylinder valve; a gas meter dial; a flame alone.
notes.A2-1255: Main picture: high pylons carrying wires across fields toward a town, and in the foreground a lit bulb hanging from a flex beside a wall socket with a plug, a small lightning glyph on the meter box. The wires feeding the lit bulb are the subject. Insets: a meter dial spinning; a switch; a lineman on a pole.
notes.A2-1256: Main picture: an electrician in overalls on a stepladder with a screwdriver in an open fuse box, a coil of cable over his shoulder, a tester in his pocket, a ceiling lamp hanging bare. The man at the wires is the subject. Insets: a plug being wired; a lineman up a pole; a bulb screwed into a socket.
notes.A2-1257: Main picture: a factory — a long brick building with two tall chimneys trailing smoke, sawtooth roofs, a gate with workers in caps streaming through, a lorry. The industrial building with its chimneys is the subject. Insets: a machine hall inside; a worker at a lathe; the factory whistle steaming.
notes.A2-1261: Main picture: a wooden house ablaze — flames roaring from the roof and windows, black smoke, a fire engine with ladders, firemen in helmets aiming hoses, a family wrapped in blankets watching. The burning building is the subject. Insets: a flame alone; a bucket chain; a burnt-out shell after.
notes.A2-1263: Main picture: a railway track at eye level — two rails on wooden sleepers and gravel running straight to the horizon, a train small in the distance, a signal post and a level crossing. The track itself is the subject. Insets: a rail joint close; a points lever; a railway worker with a hammer.
notes.A2-1264: Main picture: a blacksmith at an anvil hammering a glowing red bar, sparks flying, tongs, horseshoes and chains hanging behind, a forge glowing. The red-hot metal under the hammer is the subject. Insets: a rusty iron nail; an iron gate; a horseshoe.
notes.A2-1265: Main picture: a large translucent honey-coloured lump of amber with a trapped insect, polished amber beads spilling from a box beside it, the Baltic shore with a woman gathering pieces behind. The glowing amber is the subject. Insets: an amber necklace on a neck; raw pieces in seaweed; a jeweller polishing.
notes.A2-1266: Main picture: a RAF ambulance van, white with a red cross and a blue roof light, rear doors open, two medics in white loading a stretcher. The marked van taking the patient is the subject. Insets: the red cross on the door; the stretcher; the siren light.
notes.A2-1270: Main picture: a flower bed edged with bricks in a front garden, tulips and marigolds in neat rows, a woman with a watering can bending over it, the house behind. The planted bed is the subject. Insets: a single tulip; a trowel in the soil; the bed seen from above as a shape.
notes.A2-1272: Main picture: a nurse in white pressing the plunger of a syringe into a patient's bared upper arm, the patient looking away with a tight mouth, a cotton swab ready. The needle going in is the subject. Insets: the syringe alone; a vial being drawn up; a plaster on the arm after.
notes.A2-1273: Main picture: the side door of a cinema with people streaming out into daylight, a bold black arrow above pointing away from the building. The doorway with the outward flow is the subject. Insets: a stadium exit tunnel; a lit exit lamp over a door with a running-man pictogram; a bus rear door with people getting off.
notes.A2-1275: Main picture: a doctor's room — a desk with papers, an examination couch with a sheet, a white-coated doctor writing, a wall chart of plain symbols, a weighing scale and a cupboard of bottles. The consulting room is the subject. Insets: the couch; the stethoscope on the desk; the door with a disc blank.
notes.A2-1276: Main picture: a family at the Kūčios table — twelve dishes, a wafer being shared, hay under the tablecloth — a decorated fir with candles and straw ornaments beside, snow and a church through the window. The Christmas Eve table with the tree is the subject. Insets: a straw ornament; a candle on the tree; a child with a gift under the tree.
notes.A2-1280: Main picture: Vilnius Cathedral — the white classical portico with six columns and the three statues on the pediment, the separate round bell tower beside it, the open square with people. The cathedral with its tower is the subject. Insets: the bell tower alone; the portico statues; a procession entering.
notes.A2-1282: Main picture: a café interior — small round tables with cups and plates of cakes, a counter with a coffee machine and a cake case, a waitress carrying a tray, a couple deep in talk at the window. The tables with their cups and cakes are the subject. Insets: a cup of coffee with a pastry; the café front with its awning; the cake case.
notes.A2-1288: Main picture: a salon — a row of three chairs before mirrors, clients under sheets having hair cut and set, a hood dryer, combs and scissors on the shelf. The salon with its chairs and mirrors is the subject. Insets: scissors and comb; a hood dryer; the shop front with a drawn pair of scissors on the sign (no letters).
notes.A2-1289: Main picture: a hairdresser in a white smock cutting the hair of a client seated under a sheet before a mirror, scissors and comb in hand, hair on the floor. The person cutting hair is the subject. Insets: scissors and comb; a razor at a neck; curlers in a woman's hair.
notes.A2-1291: Main picture: a bookshop — tall shelves of books to the ceiling, tables of stacked books, a woman browsing with one open, a seller at a counter with a till. The shop of books is the subject. Insets: a stack of new books; a hand pulling a book from a shelf; the shop window.
notes.A2-1293: Main picture: a concert hall from the back of the stalls — a wide stage with a full orchestra, tiers of red seats filling, chandeliers, a conductor arriving. The great hall with its stage is the subject. Insets: a row of seats; a balcony; the hall façade with columns.
notes.A2-1294: Main picture: a ticket inspector with a red armband and a badge punching a passenger's ticket inside a trolleybus, other passengers holding out tickets. The inspector checking tickets is the subject. Insets: a ticket punch; a punched ticket; a passenger searching his pockets.
notes.A2-1299: Main picture: a woman bending over a steaming pot with her eyes closed inhaling, bold wavy scent lines rising from the pot into her nose. The rising scent lines are the subject. Insets: a man sniffing a rose with scent lines; a dog with its nose up and scent lines; a perfume bottle with lines.
notes.A2-1302: Main picture: a child licking a two-scoop ice cream in a wafer cone, a drip running down, a street ice-cream seller's cart with a white box behind. The ice cream in its cone is the subject. Insets: an ice cream on a stick; a bowl of ice cream with a spoon; the cart.
notes.A2-1303: Main picture: an open lift in a block hallway — a small cabin with three people inside, the floor indicator lamps above the door, a button panel with blank buttons, a man about to step in. The cabin behind its doors is the subject. Insets: the button panel; the cabin ceiling lamp; the shaft with cables seen through a gap.
notes.A2-1308: Main picture: a curtained cubicle in a clothes shop, curtain half drawn, a woman inside before a mirror holding a dress against herself, hangers over the rail, a shop assistant waiting with another dress. The small curtained room for trying clothes is the subject. Insets: the curtain rail with hangers; feet beneath the curtain; the mirror.
notes.A2-1311: Main picture: a repairman in overalls kneeling at an opened washing machine in a kitchen, a toolbox open beside him, parts laid on a cloth, the housewife watching. The craftsman at the repair is the subject. Insets: hands with pliers on a wire; a cobbler at a shoe; a watchmaker with an eyeglass.
notes.A2-1312: Main picture: a schoolboy of ten in a dark uniform with a white collar sitting at a wooden school desk, satchel hung on its side, a textbook open, writing with a pencil, the chalkboard behind. The pupil at his desk is the subject. Insets: pupils filing into a classroom; a satchel; a report book with ticks only.
notes.A2-1313: Main picture: a street fair in early spring — stalls heaped with dried-flower verbos, wooden spoons, baskets, woollen socks and gingerbread hearts, a dense crowd in winter coats, a fiddler. The crowded stalls of crafts are the subject. Insets: a bunch of verbos; a woodcarver at his stall; a child with a gingerbread heart.
notes.A2-1314: Main picture: a customs officer in a peaked cap and uniform lifting clothes from an open suitcase on a counter, the traveller waiting with his passport, a barrier behind. The officer searching the case is the subject. Insets: a stamp in a passport; a sniffer dog; the barrier with a lorry.
notes.A2-1316: Main picture: a room at midnight — a wall clock with both hands straight up, friends raising champagne glasses, a decorated fir, fireworks bursting over snowy rooftops through the window. The midnight toast is the subject. Insets: the clock face at twelve; a cork flying; a calendar changing to a fresh page.
notes.A2-1317: Main picture: an operating theatre — three masked and gowned surgeons bending over a patient under a great round lamp, a nurse passing an instrument, a tray of tools, a drip stand. The surgeons at work under the lamp are the subject. Insets: gloved hands with a scalpel; the lamp; the patient wheeled on a trolley.
notes.A2-1318: Main picture: an optician's shop — a wall of spectacle frames on racks, a customer trying a pair before a mirror, an eye chart of plain symbols, the optician with a lens box. The shop of spectacles is the subject. Insets: a pair of glasses alone; the eye chart; a lens being fitted.
notes.A2-1324: Main picture: a shop assistant in a white smock and cap behind a counter, cutting and weighing a wedge of cheese on a scale for a customer with a string bag, shelves of goods behind. The person serving across the counter is the subject. Insets: hands wrapping a parcel in paper; an abacus and till; the assistant stocking a shelf.
notes.A2-1325: Main picture: a tiered hall with a lecturer at a lectern speaking and pointing at a chalkboard diagram, students on the benches writing fast, a projector throwing a diagram slide. The lecturer addressing the hall is the subject. Insets: a notebook with wavy lines being filled; the lectern with a glass of water; students filing in with bags.
notes.A2-1326: Main picture: a postman in a uniform cap with a bulging shoulder bag handing letters to a woman at her garden gate, his bicycle leaning on the fence. The man delivering letters is the subject. Insets: letters going into a letterbox; the bag full of envelopes; the postman on his bicycle.
notes.A2-1335: Main picture: a clinic reception window — a nurse in white handing a card to a patient, a wall of small drawers of record cards behind her, a queue on chairs along the wall. The window with its card drawers is the subject. Insets: a record card (blank lines); a wall clock with a bench beneath; a patient's coat on a hook.
notes.A2-1336: Main picture: a doctor in white holding a large X-ray film of a chest and ribs up to a lit viewing box, the skeleton clear, the patient standing behind a machine screen. The film of bones held to the light is the subject. Insets: the film of a hand; the X-ray machine; a plaster cast being checked.
notes.A2-1344: Main picture: a crossroads at an angle from above — two streets crossing at right angles, traffic lights on each corner, cars approaching from all four directions, a zebra crossing on each arm. The crossing of the two roads is the subject. Insets: the four-way shape alone as a diagram; a traffic policeman with a baton in the middle; a signpost with blank boards.
notes.A2-1345: Main picture: a plumber on his back under a kitchen sink turning a wrench on a pipe joint, a drip falling into a bucket, his toolbag open. The man at the pipes is the subject. Insets: a tap being fitted; a burst pipe spraying; a radiator valve.
notes.A2-1347: Main picture: the parliament chamber — curved rows of benches with members at desks, a speaker at the rostrum, a very large tricolour and the Vytis on the wall behind, gallery above. The assembly in its chamber is the subject. Insets: a hand raised in a vote; the building façade with the flag; a ballot box.
notes.A2-1348: Main picture: a narrow curving cobbled lane in Vilnius Old Town, tall rendered houses in ochre and faded pink, an arched gateway, a baroque church tower closing the view, people strolling. The old lane with its old houses is the subject. Insets: a courtyard through an arch; red roofs from above; a cobbled corner with a lamp.
notes.A2-1360: Main picture: a theatre — actors in period costume on a lit stage before a painted backdrop, footlights, the red curtain half drawn, rows of audience in the dark. The acted scene on the stage is the subject. Insets: a playbill frame left blank; an actor bowing; opera glasses.
notes.A2-1362: Main picture: a young athlete in a tracksuit with a blank number bib stretching a leg on a cinder track, hurdles and a stadium behind, a stopwatch in a coach's hand. The sportsman on the track is the subject. Insets: a runner at the finish; a basketball player shooting; a medal on a ribbon.
notes.A2-1363: Main picture: a shed bursting apart in a ball of flame and black smoke, boards and a wheel flying, two men flung back with arms up, a crater forming. The burst itself is the subject. Insets: a mushroom of smoke on the horizon; a shattered window; a fireman with a hose after.
notes.A2-1365: Main picture: a building site — a tower crane swinging a panel, scaffolding on a half-built block, workers in helmets, a cement mixer, a board fence. The site under construction is the subject. Insets: a bricklayer with a trowel; a helmet; a wheelbarrow of sand.
notes.A2-1370: Main picture: a judge in a black robe seated at a high bench, gavel raised, the tricolour on the wall behind, lawyers at tables below. The robed figure at the bench is the subject. Insets: the gavel; scales of justice; the courthouse steps.
notes.A2-1374: Main picture: a street — a worker with a pneumatic drill breaking asphalt, a lorry with a roaring engine, a woman with both hands clamped over her ears grimacing, bold jagged sound lines everywhere. The din is the subject. Insets: a drum being beaten; a baby crying; a jackhammer alone.
notes.A2-1375: Main picture: a stop shelter under the twin overhead wires, a trolleybus with its poles up pulling in, a queue of six, the stop sign with a blank disc. The stop beneath the wires with the arriving trolleybus is the subject. Insets: the wires and poles; the shelter bench; a ticket.
notes.A2-1376: Main picture: a small tiled room with a WC pan, wooden seat and high cistern with a pull chain, a toilet-paper roll, the door ajar bearing man-and-woman pictograms. The toilet pan is the subject. Insets: the door pictograms; a washbasin and tap; a public toilet entrance with steps down.
notes.A2-1379: Main picture: a railway conductor in full uniform — peaked cap with a plain band, dark jacket with brass buttons and shoulder boards, whistle on a cord — standing beside a carriage. notes.A2-1421: Main picture: a woman sitting up in bed and swinging her feet down to her slippers, pushing back the blanket, the alarm clock ringing beside her, low morning sun. notes.A2-1422: Main picture: a man seated on a hall stool pulling a leather boot onto his raised foot with both hands, the second boot waiting on the floor, a coat on the hook behind. notes.A2-1423: Main picture: a polling station in a school hall — a woman dropping a folded paper into the slot of a sealed wooden box, a curtained booth behind her, two officials at a table with a ledger, the tricolour on the wall. The ballot going into the box is the subject. Insets: a hand marking a cross on a paper; the curtained booth; a queue at the door.
notes.A2-1424: Main picture: a painter in overalls rolling light-blue paint onto a wall, the left half already coloured and the right still grey, a tin and a brush on the floor, drops on a sheet. notes.A2-1425: Main picture: a woman holding out an apple to a small boy, the apple between their two hands, his hand opening to take it, a bold arrow from her hand to his. notes.A2-1429: Main picture: close on scissors closing on a lock of hair held between a comb and fingers, cut hair falling to the sheet on a client's shoulders, a mirror. The cutting of the hair is the subject. Insets: scissors cutting cloth; a sheep being shorn; a hedge being clipped.
notes.A2-1430: Main picture: a man in a coat hunched and coughing hard into his fist, bold burst lines from his mouth, a handkerchief in the other hand, people stepping aside. notes.A2-1805: Main picture: the Lithuanian tricolour — yellow, green and red bands — flying from a tall pole against a clear sky, a hand hauling the rope, a building below. notes.A2-1807: Main picture: a man on foot crossing a road at a zebra crossing, the black arrow on him, a Zhiguli and a cyclist stopped at the line for contrast. notes.A2-1817: Main picture: a man holding out a wrapped gift box with a bow to a woman whose hands open to receive it, both smiling, a birthday table behind. notes.A2-1818: Main picture: a man on his hands and knees peering under a sofa with a torch, cushions flung aside, drawers pulled open, his wife lifting a rug, the whole room turned over. notes.A2-1826: Main picture: a woman at an ironing board pressing a shirt with a heavy iron, steam rising, the collar smooth under the iron, a stack of pressed shirts, a basket of crumpled ones. notes.A2-1827: Main picture: close on a grandmother's hands knitting with two needles, a half-finished sock on them, a ball of wool unwinding from a basket, a child beside trying a finished mitten. notes.A2-1832: Main picture: a man pulling a jumper up and off over his head, arms up inside it, his coat already over a chair and shoes kicked off, a bed behind. notes.A2-1862: Main picture: a woman mid-sneeze — head thrown back, eyes screwed shut, mouth open, bold burst lines from the nose, a handkerchief flying up in her hand, a man beside her ducking.
